en: The postcard features an old black-and-white photograph bordered by a decorated frame. The photo shows a prominent church with a tall spire and clock tower on the left, and a large, classical public building on the right with fenced grounds and trees. The text printed in red at the bottom identifies the location as Sundsvall and labels the buildings as 'Kyrkan och Allm. Läroverket' (The Church and General School). Handwritten notes in Swedish are present. The address side has ornate green framing, a green Swedish stamp depicting a monarch, and handwritten recipient details.
